construct: RULED, THE K2 CELL (refreshed 2026-09-21): k2_overview 40–70w (the persona's current in the element's arena) + k2_functional ≤22w (the god's own family function, re-ruled 2026-09-01) + k2_domain_readings 18–55w per ruled domain (owner construct 2026-08-19, corpus ×50 LOCKED) · adj_chips {catalyst ×3, friction ×3} 1–3w under THE KEYWORD DERIVATION CHAIN (2026-09-03) and THE VOCABULARY ZONE B1–B2 (2026-09-04) · fn_reading = the weighted three-door ledger {word, doors:{trait, scene, outside}} ×3 per pole, 35–55w per door (THE THREE DOORS 2026-09-03; corpus ×50 complete 2026-09-04) · structural_interaction = the REA_03 §4b authoring seed · k2_card = the unauthored register stub (REA_03 §4, superseded by the cell above). Prompts: REA_17 §3.4. · edge (catalyst pole only; owner 2026-10-16, THE EDGE v9: two sentences, the energy and its three ruling domains from the GOD table, then a clause per domain in The Pattern's voice; the metric; the head derived in the app)

candidates.structural_interaction: Water generating Wood same-polarity — depth as natural source of effortless reach
candidates.k2_overview: Your Wood moves as the Artisan: growth that fruits. Everything you tend produces, gardens, projects, people, and the producing feels less like work than like season. You nourish by cultivating: patient feeding, honest pruning, harvests shared at the fence. Your gift ripens on its own schedule. Respect the schedule.
candidates.k2_functional: Your words grow on people slowly and stay. You persuade the way spring does.

k2_domain_readings.Expression: Your expression bears fruit: gardens, meals, projects that people can taste and hold. Make output a rhythm rather than an event. An orchard produces because producing is simply what it does.
k2_domain_readings.Enjoyment: You enjoy abundance in its natural forms: tables full, gardens loud, seasons honored with their own pleasures. Guard the fallow time too. Delight, like soil, needs its resting years.
k2_domain_readings.Children: You are patient with children and students. You feed them, give them space, and let them grow at their own speed rather than yours, and you enjoy the raising more than the results.

catalyst.define: As a catalyst, the growth stays low to the ground. What you let out is small and warm, and it seldom reaches past the people nearest you.

angles.drive: For you, giving comes before being asked. You feel most yourself with something to hand over, so you give before knowing whether anyone needs it. Your kitchen, your toolbox and your time are open to whoever walks in.
angles.cost_self: Giving first is how you make sure you matter. Because you would rather give than receive, you hardly ever let anyone give to you. Underneath is a wish to be loved for who you are, empty-handed.
angles.cost_others: You hand things over before anyone near you can ask. Giving first feels easier than being asked, so you give at the first sign. The people you love rarely get to say what they wanted from you.

angles.drive: You are always making something, and the making matters more than the result. Busy hands keep you steady, and you start the next thing rather than show the last. Your home fills with useful, lovely pieces nobody else would have made.
angles.cost_self: Stopping feels like disappearing, and making keeps you here. The joy for you is in the making, and you make something new instead of staying idle. Fine work of yours sits in drawers, unseen and unthanked.
angles.cost_others: Most of your answers come as things made rather than said. Making is where you feel useful, and you keep making while you half listen. Friends who drop by to talk often find your eyes on your work.

angles.drive: You stay relaxed on purpose. Enjoying what is in front of you matters more than getting ahead, and good enough is good enough for you. People breathe easier at your table, and nobody feels hurried there.
angles.cost_self: Staying relaxed is how you keep life good. Pushing feels like spoiling the day, and you take the comfortable choice rather than the forward one. Some of your bigger chances drift past unclaimed.
angles.cost_others: With those in your care, you keep things relaxed. Since you would rather be enjoyed than obeyed, you let a child or student set their own pace. Those you teach learn without fear of getting it wrong in front of you.

friction.define: As a friction, the current spreads wide and shallow. Your strength drains away into pleasant hours, because each day has to feel good.

angles.drive: Coasting is how you move through most days. You finish what comes easily rather than what needs a push, since effort never felt like the point. You coast a long way on ease and stop just short of the finish.
angles.cost_self: Coasting feels like being yourself. You keep the fun half of every project rather than the hard half, and the rest waits for later. Coasting past the finish costs you the joy of a thing done, the pleasure you miss most.
angles.cost_others: You coast on people who already like you. Since you feel safe with them, you give them the easy version instead of the effort you spend on strangers. You give your least trying to those who love you most.

angles.drive: Saying no has never come easily to you. A no feels like going missing, so you say yes before checking whether you have it to give. You are allowed to check first, because a later, tired you keeps each yes.
angles.cost_self: Never saying no is how you stay loved. You would rather be tired than be the one who said no, so you run on less rest than anyone around you knows. You lose sleep to each yes, and one no wins some of it back.
angles.cost_others: A no feels unkind to you, every time. Because a yes keeps the peace while a no risks it, you agree to whatever your family asks rather than weigh what you have left. Never saying no, you hand your family none of your own wishes.

angles.drive: Comfort comes first with you. Because feeling good now is more real than feeling glad later, you take the soft option over the one that pays off. You put second to comfort the very thing you wanted most.
angles.cost_self: Putting comfort first gets you through a hard week. Because the easy choice calms you now and the right one pays later, you take calm rather than right. Count the good chances you let go by to stay comfortable, since few of them come back.
angles.cost_others: You put comfort first for those in your care too. You would rather see them happy now than stretched, and you pick the easy choice over the useful one. You trade the effort they would grow on for an hour of ease.

retired_2026-09-20_batch3.k2_domain_readings.Children: Children and students flourish around you like well-watered rows: fed patiently, staked when young, given sun and left to grow. Your line, biological or chosen, tends to be fruitful and fond of you.

edge.lead: Wood runs through your health, your family and your career. It is the slow pulse a bad day cannot speed up, the lamp left on for whoever comes home late, and the work that arrives finished while the loud ones still talk.
